title: Read-only `engram source` gate admission: test discrimination and exact-argv Lows from the c4c0 review
outcome: Read-only `engram source` gate admission: test discrimination and exact-argv Lows from the c4c0 review
acceptance: An `engram source --root R --json` command followed by an empty word ('' or "") is refused by the read-only Bash gate.
The gate's focused tests distinguish a clean root from a dirty root and fail under the mutations the c4c0 Claude review listed.
The refusal diagnostics for a rejected `engram source` form name the rejected argument.
